items.description: Adds the `tb-jira` commands to `thor-jira`: `auth` stores, removes, and reports the Jira API token in the macOS keychain, `issue list` lists a project's work items, and `configure-project` reconciles a Jira Cloud project's statuses, workflow transitions, and board features against `jira-project-spec.json`, with a `--dry-run` preview. (#532)

Adds the `@williamthorsen/atlassian-tools` package with a `thor-jira` binary, which prints its help for `--help`, `-h`, or no arguments and exits with code 2 on any other argument, to hold the `tb-jira` port in #520. (#527)
